name: Group Administration Assistant
description: Manages group membership, join requests, settings and subgroups. Administrators with the appropriate role can moderate messages, review reports, warn members, and suspend or expel them.

workflows.description: Guided subgroup creation before the managed group is created.
Guided pin-duration choice before a quoted message is pinned.

assistant.summary: Moderates the groups of a scope (a community or standalone groups): suspensions and expulsions, member reports, a spam and raid shield, and etiquette rules.
useCases: Suspend a member for a number of days: they are removed from every group here and added back when it ends.
Expel a member: they are removed from every group here and kept out.
Take member reports and let admins act on them privately.
Remove obvious spam, lock a group during a raid, and warn about etiquette rules.
prerequisites: Groups must be in MANAGE mode, with the bot as admin, for removals, deletions and locks.
WABP core API 0.3.24 or later, for member standings.
limitations: Only admins of the authority groups may moderate; the bot by itself only expels obvious spam from members who joined recently.
What a suspension or expulsion means for other host features (for example chat history) is decided by the host, not this plugin.
dryRun=true (the default) only records decisions in the audit log.
